audience: practice managers and front-desk staff at clinics that use Cliniko for scheduling and billing

useCases.title: Find open appointment slots for a practitioner
useCases.text: The AI lists bookable slots for a business, practitioner and appointment type within a date range of up to 7 days. You can see when the practitioner has openings.

useCases.title: Get the next available time for a service
useCases.text: The AI looks up the single next bookable slot for a business, practitioner and appointment type, from a date you give. It answers when the next opening is.

useCases.title: List your practice locations and practitioners
useCases.text: The AI lists the businesses (practice locations) and practitioners in the account. You get an overview of who works in the practice and where.

useCases.title: Review the services and products you bill
useCases.text: The AI lists the appointment types (service definitions) and the billable products and items. You can check what the practice offers and sells.

useCases.title: Check the Cliniko account and subscription details
useCases.text: The AI reads the account and subscription details for the API key. It is a quick way to confirm the connection works before other tasks.
